blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: While LLM agents can generate visually plausible CAD assemblies, these designs often fail to fulfill their intended physical functions. We study functional CAD design, a setting where agents interpret underspecified requests to construct and iteratively revise mechanisms that satisfy functional requirements in physical simulation. Verifying these requirements is nontrivial: different candidate mechanisms may realize the same function through entirely different components, controls, and operating sequences. To bridge this gap, we propose FunCAD-Harness, a framework that translates abstract requirements into candidate-specific physical tests and uses simulation feedback to guide design revisions. To systematically evaluate this capability, we introduce FunCADBench, a benchmark spanning 46 mechanism families with interdependent and multi-step operations. Experiments across frontier LLM agents show that FunCAD-Harness exposes subtle mechanical failures invisible to visual inspection, substantially improving functional success rates over standard simulation-augmented baselines. Ultimately, our work marks a step toward CAD agents capable of translating human intent into working mechanisms.
blocks.zh: 虽然LLM代理可以产生视觉上可信的 CAD 组件,但这些设计往往不能实现预期的物理功能. 我们研究功能性的 CAD 设计,一种由代理人解释未明确要求的设置,即构造和迭代修改机制,以满足物理模拟中的功能要求. 验证这些要求是非三角性的:不同的候选机制可能通过完全不同的组件,控制和操作序列来实现相同的功能. 为了弥补这一差距,我们提出FunCAD-Harness,这个框架将抽象的要求转化为针对候选人的物理测试,并使用模拟反馈来指导设计修改. 为了系统地评估这一能力,我们引入了FunCABennch,这一基准涵盖46个具有相互依存和多步骤业务的机制家庭。 跨越边界的LLM剂实验表明,FunCAD-Harness暴露出视觉检查看不见的微妙机械故障,大大改善了功能成功率,超过了标准模拟强化基线. 归根结底,我们的工作标志着向有能力将人类意图转化为工作机制的CAD代理人迈出了一步。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: A longstanding ambition for generative AI is to turn human intentions into machines that can be built and made to work. Recent progress in LLM agents brings this ambition closer, enabling them to write modeling programs and operate CAD software to construct sophisticated mechanical designs for fabrication by 3D printing or CNC machining. Yet a visually plausible CAD model does not ensure that the resulting machine will fulfill the user’s request, because its function depends on how its parts interact physically during operation. Even an assembly with valid parts and plausible articulation can fail to transmit a load, maintain contact, or return to a state that permits the next operation. A gripper, for example, may grasp an object successfully but leave it poorly positioned after release, preventing the next grasp. Because fabricating and assembling each candidate is costly, physical simulation offers a practical way to examine these interactions under specified inputs and loads and use the resulting feedback to revise the design.
blocks.zh: 基因AI的一个长期野心是将人类的用心转化为可以被建造和制造的机器来工作. 最近LLM代理器的进步使这种野心更加接近,使他们能够写出模型程序并操作CAD软件来构建出精密的机械设计来由3D打印或CNC机械制造来制造. 然而,一个可视化的CAD模型并不能确保所产生的机器能够满足用户的要求,因为其功能取决于其部件在操作期间的物理互动。 即使是装有有效零件和合理配音的组装,也可能无法传输负载,保持接触,或返回允许下一次操作的状态. 例如,抓取器可以成功地抓住一个物体,但在释放后使其位置差,从而阻止了下一次抓取。 由于制作和组装每个候选人的费用高昂,物理模拟提供了一种实用的方法,在指定的投入和负荷下审查这些相互作用,并利用由此产生的反馈来修改设计。

blocks.en: Verifying a design through physical simulation, however, requires tests that reflect both the user’s intended function and the way the candidate mechanism realizes it. Users often describe what they want a machine to accomplish without specifying all the behaviors needed to achieve it. Even when these requirements are made explicit, they do not uniquely determine an experiment, because the same function can be realized by mechanisms that operate differently. For an alarm that must trigger autonomously at a requested time, a gravity-powered design requires raising a weight, whereas a mainspring-powered design requires winding. A test designed around one mechanism can therefore be inappropriate for the other, even though the intended function is unchanged.
blocks.zh: 但是,通过物理模拟验证设计需要测试,既反映用户的预期功能,又反映候选机制实现这种功能的方式。 用户经常描述他们想要一台机器实现什么,而没有具体说明实现它所需的所有行为. 即使这些要求被明确,它们也不独有地决定一个实验,因为运行不同的机制可以实现同样的功能. 对于在要求的时间必须自主触发的警报,重力动力设计需要提高重量,而主泉动力设计需要起风. 因此,围绕一种机制设计的试验可能不适合另一种机制,即使预期的功能不变。

blocks.en: We study whether LLM agents can carry this process from an underspecified request to a CAD mechanism that satisfies its functional requirements in simulation, a problem we term functional CAD design . To examine how far current agents can go on this task, we introduce FunCADBench, a benchmark spanning 46 mechanism families. Its tasks range from clamps and transmissions to mechanical counters, alarm clocks, and coin-sorting devices, whose functions depend on different combinations of geometry, force transmission, and changing contact states. Each task specifies a fixed request and an abstract functional test template while leaving the mechanical realization open. Success requires the resulting assembly to perform the complete requested behavior and satisfy the applicable geometric and physical constraints. Since repeated physical simulation can be costly for complex mechanisms, we develop a customized simulation environment to support efficient benchmark evaluation.
blocks.zh: 我们研究LLM代理是否能够将这个过程从一个不精确的请求带到一个满足其在模拟中的功能要求的CAD机制,我们称之为功能CAD设计的问题. 为了审查目前的代理人能够在多大程度上完成这项任务,我们引入了FunCADBennch,这个基准涵盖46个机制家庭。 其任务范围从夹子和传输到机械计数器,闹钟和硬币分相器,其功能取决于几何,力传输,和不断变化的接触状态的不同组合. 每个任务都指定一个固定请求和一个抽象的功能测试模板,同时让机械实现打开. 成功需要由此产生的组装来进行完全要求的行为并满足适用的几何和物理限制. 由于重复的物理模拟对于复杂的机制来说成本很高,因此我们开发出一个定制的模拟环境,以支持有效的基准评价.

blocks.en: For this specific task, we develop FunCAD-Harness, which translates user requests into task requirements and abstract physical test templates. It then determines test conditions appropriate to the candidate mechanism and uses structured simulation feedback to guide design revision. Fig. 1 illustrates this workflow through an open-ended cup-access design and its printed prototype.
blocks.zh: 对于这一具体任务,我们开发了FunCAD-Harness,将用户请求转化为任务要求和抽象的物理测试模板. 然后确定适合候选机制的测试条件,并使用结构化的模拟反馈来指导设计修改. 图1通过开放式的杯子访问设计及其印刷原型说明了这一工作流程。

blocks.en: With FunCAD-Harness, we evaluate frontier models and baseline workflows on FunCADBench and find that structured physical testing and diagnostic feedback improve task success. The model comparisons also show that strong visual 3D modeling capabilities do not necessarily translate into superior functional design. To better understand how agents approach this task, we analyze their tool use and observe that they rely primarily on CAD programs and simulation, with little use of rendered images. Testing the role of visual access directly, a separate experiment shows that substantial task success remains possible when it is removed from the constructor.
blocks.zh: 有了FunCAD-Harness,我们评价了FunCABench上的前沿模型和基线工作流程,发现结构化的物理测试和诊断反馈改善了任务的成功. 模型比较还显示,强大的视觉3D模型能力并不一定会转化为优越的功能设计. 为了更好地理解代理如何接近这项任务,我们分析他们的工具使用,并观察到他们主要依赖CAD程序和模拟,很少使用渲染的图像. 直接测试视觉访问的作用,一个单独的实验显示,当从构造器中去除时,实质性的任务成功仍然是可能的.

blocks.en: In summary, our contributions are: • We formulate functional CAD design , in which agents translate underspecified requests into mechanisms that fulfill their intended functions in simulation, and introduce FunCADBench, spanning 46 mechanism families, with a simulation environment for efficient physical evaluation. • We develop FunCAD-Harness, which derives requirements and abstract test templates from user requests, constructs physical tests suited to candidate mechanisms, and uses structured simulation feedback to guide iterative design and revision. • We systematically evaluate frontier agents and baseline workflows, demonstrating the benefits of physical testing and diagnostic feedback. Our analyses further reveal performance–cost tradeoffs and recurring challenges in functional mechanical design.
blocks.zh: 简而言之,我们的贡献是: 我们制定实用的CAD设计,其中代理商将未明确的要求转化为在模拟中实现预期功能的机制,并引入FunCADBench,涵盖46个机制家族,并有一个模拟环境来进行高效的物理评价. ? 我们开发了FunCAD-Harness,它从用户请求中获取要求和抽象测试模板,构建适合候选机制的物理测试,并使用结构化的模拟反馈来指导迭代设计和修订. ^ 我们系统地评估前沿代理人和基线工作流程,展示物理测试和诊断反馈的好处。 我们的分析进一步揭示了在功能机械设计方面的性能-成本取舍和反复出现的挑战。

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: Mechanical design and AI for engineering. Mechanical design connects intended functions to the structure and motion of mechanisms ( Reuleaux, 2013 ) . Computational approaches optimize mechanisms and structural topology ( Coros et al., 2013 ; Bendsøe et al., 2004 ) , while learned models predict performance and generate candidate designs ( Umetani & Bickel, 2018 ; Regenwetter et al., 2022 ) . Co-design accounts for dependencies between morphology, motion, and control ( Ha et al., 2016 ; Yuan et al., 2022 ) , and between hardware and software under resource and compatibility constraints ( Carlone & Pinciroli, 2019 ) . LLMs connect natural-language specifications to design generation, analysis, and optimization tools ( Makatura et al., 2023 ) . Executable evaluation supports both benchmarking, as in EngDesign’s cross-domain design tasks ( Guo et al., 2025 ) , and search, as in VLMgineer’s simulation-guided evolutionary co-design of robot-mounted tool geometry and action waypoints ( Gao et al., 2026 ) . Closest to our setting, BesiegeField studies compositional machine design from textual functional demands, assembling standardized components in a game-based simulator and using simulation rewards and state feedback to revise the assembly ( Zhang et al., 2026 ) . Our CAD setting expands the design space beyond predefined blocks: agents jointly synthesize part geometry, assembly structure, and operating inputs to realize the requested functions, producing CAD models that provide a basis for eventual fabrication.
blocks.zh: 机械设计和工程的AI. 机械设计将预期的功能与机制的结构和运动相接(Reuleaux,2013.). 计算方法优化了机制和结构地貌(Coros等,2013年;Bendsøe等,2004年),同时学习模型预测性能并生成候选设计(Umetani和Bickel,2018年;Regenwetter等,2022年). 共同设计说明形态学,运动与控制之间的依存关系(Ha等,2016;袁等,2022),以及资源与相容性约束下的硬件与软件之间的依存关系(Carlone & Pinciroli,2019). LLMS将自然语言规范与设计生成,分析和优化工具相连接(Makatura等,2023.). 可执行评价支持两个基准,如EngDeign的跨域设计任务(Guo等,2025年)和搜索,如VLMgineer的模拟-引导演化协同设计机器人上载工具几何和动作路由点(Gao等,2026年). Besiege Fellows从文字功能需求研究组成机器设计,在游戏模拟器中集成标准化组件,并使用模拟奖励和状态反馈修改组装(张等,2026年). 我们的 CAD 设置将设计空间扩展到预先定义的块以外: 代理人联合合成部分几何,组装结构,以及操作输入来实现所请求的函数, 生成 CAD 模型,为最终制造提供基础.

blocks.en: Programmatic CAD and physically grounded assets. Programmatic CAD and graphics representations make modeling operations and part composition editable ( Ritchie et al., 2023 ; Wu et al., 2023 ; Li et al., 2025 ) , with compilation, rendered views, and CAD-engine diagnostics providing feedback on geometric fidelity and modeling validity ( Alrashedy et al., 2025 ; Gong et al., 2026 ) . Assembly benchmarks extend evaluation to functionality, manufacturability, and assemblability through executable geometry checks and drawing-based VLM judgments under supplied assembly graphs and engineering constraints ( Dong et al., 2026 ) . Articulated-asset generation further tests how parts interact, using agent-authored checks of contact, clearance, containment, and pose-dependent relations ( Zhou et al., 2026 ) , or independent review and physical simulation of collisions, stability, and manipulation feasibility for coupled motions ( Cai et al., 2026 ) . Whereas these approaches assess the realization and functional usability of specified objects, FunCADBench evaluates alternative mechanism architectures against a functional request’s complete operating requirements, including load transmission and dependent or repeated operations.
blocks.zh: 方案CAD和实体资产。 程序化的CAD和图形表示使模型操作和部分组成可以编辑(Ritchie等,2023;Wu等,2023;Li等,2025;Li等,2025;CAD-引擎诊断提供几何忠诚度和模型有效性的反馈(Alrashedy等,2025;Gong等,2026)。 根据提供的组装图和工程限制,通过可执行几何检查和以绘图为基础的VLM判断,将评价扩大到功能、可制造性和可混合性(Dong等人,2026年)。 人工化-资产生成进一步测试部件如何相互作用,利用代理人授权的接触、清除、遏制和相依赖的关系(周等,2026年),或对碰撞、稳定性和相偶运动的操纵可行性进行独立审查和物理模拟(蔡等,2026年)。 虽然这些方法评估特定物体的实现和功能可用性,但FunCADBench对照功能请求的完整操作要求,包括负载传输和依赖或重复操作,评价了替代机制架构.

blocks.en: Agent workflows, harnesses, and executable evaluation. Agent interfaces and runtimes organize tool use, context, and execution feedback ( Yang et al., 2024 ; Wang et al., 2025 ) , while automated search optimizes workflows and full harness programs against supplied evaluators ( Zhang et al., 2025 ; Lee et al., 2026 ) . Executable checks also guide artifact construction within a workflow, from stage gates for robot-learning environments, interfaces, rewards, and training configurations ( Li et al., 2026 ) to geometric checks and finite-element stress and safety-factor feedback for structural CAD under prescribed loads, supports, and design-space constraints ( Berger et al., 2026 ) . To accommodate generated implementations, software testing can adapt test inputs against a trusted reference and retain counterexamples for regression testing ( Kato, 2026 ) , or bind fixed functional tests to implementation-specific identifiers ( Liu et al., 2025 ) . FunCAD-Harness extends candidate-specific test binding to operating mechanisms whose geometry, assembly, and inputs vary across designs. Registered requirements and abstract test templates remain fixed, while actuation, loads, and observations are bound to each candidate for simulation and source-geometry checks. This evaluates complete mechanism operation rather than structural response to a prescribed load case, and supplies feedback for structural revision.
blocks.zh: 代理工作流程、工具以及可执行评价。 代理界面和运行时间组织工具使用,上下文,以及执行反馈(杨等,2024;王等,2025;而自动搜索则对提供的评价人员优化了工作流程和充分利用程序(张等,2025;李等,2026. 可执行检查还指导在工作流程内,从用于机器人学习环境、界面、奖励和培训配置的舞台大门(Li等,2026年)到几何检查和有限压力及安全因素反馈,供结构CAD在规定负载、支持和设计-空间限制下使用(Berger等,2026年)。 为了适应生成的实现,软件测试可以根据一个可信赖的引用来调整测试输入,并保留反向实例来进行回归测试(Kato, 2026),或者将固定功能测试与执行特定识别符绑定(Liu等, 2025). FunCAD-Harness将针对候选人的测试范围延伸至操作机制,其几何、组装和投入因设计而异。 注册要求和抽象测试模板仍然固定,而激活,负载和观测则被绑定在每个候选者身上,用于模拟和源几何检查. 这评价了整个机制的运作,而不是对规定的负载情况的结构反应,并为结构修订提供反馈。

blocks.en: 3 FunCADBench: Benchmark for Functional CAD Design
blocks.zh: 3 FunCABENCH:功能性CAD设计基准

blocks.en: 3.1 Functional CAD design
blocks.zh: 3.1 功能性CAD设计

blocks.en:
Mechanical design involves production cost, manufacturing processes, and regulatory requirements as well as mechanical behavior ( Pahl et al., 2007 ; Nisbett & Budynas, 2020 ) . We focus on interpreting high-level user requests and determining whether a CAD mechanism fulfills the intended functions under appropriate physical conditions ( Zhang et al., 2026 ) .
Formally speaking, each task of functional CAD design is specified by a natural-language request describing a mechanism’s intended use. The request establishes its functional requirements , which describe the behaviors to achieve, and fixed constraints , which must be preserved throughout design. The agent produces a candidate design together with declared physical assumptions . Different mechanical implementations are acceptable as long as they satisfy these requirements; for example, a clamp may use different actuation mechanisms, but it must still close, hold an object, and release it.
blocks.zh:
机械设计涉及生产成本、制造工艺和监管要求以及机械行为(Pahl等,2007年;Nisbett & Budynas,2020年)。 我们侧重于解释高端用户请求,并确定CAD机制在适当的物理条件下是否实现预期功能(张等,2026年).
从形式上讲,功能性CAD设计的每一项任务都由描述一个机制的预期用途的自然语言请求来指定. 该请求规定了其功能要求,其中描述了要实现的行为,以及必须在整个设计过程中保持的固定约束。 代理商制作一个候选设计以及申报的物理假设 不同的机械执行只要满足这些要求就可以被接受;例如,夹子可能使用不同的活化机制,但它必须仍然关闭,持有一个物体并放出.

blocks.en: 3.2 Task Families and Taxonomy
blocks.zh: 3.2 任务家庭和分类

blocks.en: To evaluate frontier LLM agents on this task across different mechanical demands, we introduce FunCADBench, a benchmark spanning 46 mechanism families (representative mechanisms are shown in Fig. 2 ). These range from elementary assemblies to coupled transmissions and devices with sequential or repeated operation. Fig. 3 shows mechanisms that LLM agents built for all 46 families in our experiments. Many of these families are drawn from familiar artifacts, such as clamps, whose intended uses can be described without specifying their internal mechanics. Several families pose open-ended mechanism design tasks that leave key architectural choices to the constructor. For example, the four-station indexing table (Task 40) must convert continuous input rotation into intermittent motion with dwell, without prescribing the indexing mechanism. We choose these families to cover different combinations of challenges along these axes–motion primitives, topology, complexity, contact, and geometric difficulty–each drawing on different agent capabilities (Table 1 ).
blocks.zh: 为了评估跨不同机械需求的前沿LLM代理商,我们引入了FunCABennch这一涵盖46个机制家庭的基准(代表性机制见图2)。 这些装置从基本装置到相继或重复操作的相接传输装置。 图3显示了LLM代理在我们实验中为全部46个家庭建立的机制. 其中许多家族取自熟悉的文物,如夹子等,其预期用途可以描述而无需具体说明其内部力学. 一些家庭承担了开放式机制设计任务,将关键的建筑选择留给建筑师。 例如,四站索引表(任务40)必须把连续的输入旋转转换为有住地的间歇运动,而无需规定索引机制. 我们选择这些家族来覆盖沿着这些轴线的不同组合的挑战 — — 运动原始、地貌、复杂、接触和几何难度 — — 每一个都利用不同的代理能力(表1)。

blocks.en: 3.3 Physical Evaluation and Success Criteria
blocks.zh: 3.3 实际评价和成功标准

blocks.en: Functional requirements specify what an assembly must accomplish, while its mechanical realization determines how those functions can be tested. Similar to the separation between test logic and implementation-specific parameters in ProjectEval ( Liu et al., 2025 ) , we define abstract test templates for the required behaviors and bind them to each candidate mechanism, while keeping the requests and templates fixed across candidates for registered benchmark tasks. This binding identifies the candidate’s operating interfaces ( e.g. , bicycle handlebars) and observation signals, and specifies the inputs, loads, physical attributes, and environmental conditions needed to execute the template. These choices reflect how the mechanism operates while preserving the task’s required functions and fixed constraints. Parameters left open by the task may be selected or revised within its permitted scope (Appendix A.4 ). Given these parameters, we run physical simulation and record feedback signals, including forces, positions, and contact or collision events, for the relevant mechanical modules. The assembly succeeds under the task’s simulation protocol if it passes all required functional checks and all applicable source-geometry checks ( e.g. , collision checks) under its declared operating conditions.
blocks.zh: 功能要求指定一个集合必须完成什么,而其机械实现则决定了这些功能如何被测试. 与"ProjectEval"(Liu等,2025年)中测试逻辑与执行特定参数的分离类似,我们定义了所需行为的抽象测试模板,并将其与每个候选机制相绑定,同时将申请和模板固定在候选人之间,用于注册基准任务. 此绑定可以识别候选人的操作界面(如自行车手柄栏)和观察信号,并指定执行模板所需的输入、负载、物理属性和环境条件。 这些选择反映了该机制如何运作,同时保留任务所需的职能和固定的制约因素。 任务留下的参数可在允许的范围内选择或修订(附录A.4)。 鉴于这些参数,我们为有关的机械模块进行物理模拟并记录反馈信号,包括力量、位置和接触或相撞事件。 如果装配在其申报的操作条件下通过所有所需的功能检查和所有适用的源几何检查(例如碰撞检查),则根据任务模拟协议成功。

blocks.en: 3.4 Simulation Environment
blocks.zh: 3.4 模拟环境

blocks.en: Physical evaluation and repeated design revision require tests that can run within an agent’s working budget. Our simulation environment uses Project Chrono ( Tasora et al., 2016 ) for rigid-body dynamics and Bullet ( Coumans, 2015 ) for collision detection. Since resolving detailed mechanical interactions can be costly, the environment also supports equivalent models. Gear couplings, for example, represent transmission between rotating components without resolving individual tooth contacts ( Coros et al., 2013 ; Tasora et al., 2016 ) .
blocks.zh: 实体评价和重复设计修订需要测试,可以在代理的工作预算内进行。 我们的模拟环境使用Chrono项目(Tasora等,2016年)来进行刚体动力学和子弹(Coumans,2015年)来进行碰撞探测. 由于解决详细的机械相互作用可能代价高昂,环境也支持等效模型. 例如,齿轮耦合代表自转部件之间的传输,而不解决单个牙齿接触(Coros等人,2013年;Tasora等人,2016年)。

blocks.en: Figure 4: Gear-transmission cost. Native time is extrapolated from its recorded mean.
blocks.zh: 图4: 吉他传输费用。 本地时间是从记录的平均值推断出来的。

blocks.en: When configuring a physical test, the agents choose between native simulation and a declared equivalent model for each interaction, recording its parameters and assumptions. If an equivalent model is used, it specifies force or torque laws for the corresponding source components, leaving the native solver to compute the resulting motion without prescribing output trajectories. Connections remain tied to finite regions of the source geometry and are released if those regions separate. The resulting motion provides the basis for functional checks, while separate audits examine the original CAD geometry at sampled poses. Appendix D describes the interaction models, audit scope, and execution procedure.
blocks.zh: 在配置物理测试时,物剂会在原生模拟和宣布的等效模型之间为每次交互选择,记录其参数和假设. 如果使用等效模型,它为相应的源元件指定了力法或扭矩法,让原生解子来计算产生的运动而无需规定输出轨迹. 连接仍与源几何的有限区域相接,如果这些区域分开,则予以释放。 由此产生的运动为功能检查提供基础,而单独的审计则在被取样的姿势上检查原始的CAD几何. 附 录 D描述了互动模式、审计范围和执行程序。

blocks.en: 4 Agentic Harness for Functional CAD Design
blocks.zh: 4 功能性CAD设计代理

blocks.en: A mechanism’s design determines how its functions can be tested, and the test results in turn inform how the design should change. FunCAD-Harness organizes this interaction into a closed loop for developing and revising CAD mechanisms (Fig. 5 ). Building on agentic CAD generation ( Zhou et al., 2026 ) and simulation-based machine design ( Zhang et al., 2026 ) , the harness pairs a constructor responsible for mechanism design with a test-binding agent responsible for preparing physical tests.
blocks.zh: 一个机制的设计决定了如何测试其功能,而测试结果反过来又为设计应如何改变提供信息。 FunCAD-Harness将这种互动组织成一个闭环来发展和修订CAD机制(图5). 以代理CAD生成(周等,2026年)和以模拟为主的机器设计(张等,2026年)为基础,将负责机制设计的构造器与负责准备物理测试的试验装订剂相配.

blocks.en: Figure 5: Overview of FunCAD-Harness, illustrated with a releasable reduction winch (Task 42).
blocks.zh: 图5:FunCAD-Harness概览,用可回放的还原绞盘来说明(任务42)。

blocks.en: 4.1 Functional requirements and test templates
blocks.zh: 4.1 功能要求和测试模板

blocks.en: The constructor starts from a text prompt specifying the functional requirements, which describe what the mechanism must accomplish while leaving its mechanical realization open. A request for an alarm clock, for example, may require it to trigger autonomously at a specified time without prescribing a particular escapement design. Each test template specifies the operations, observations, and success criteria for verifying the requested behavior, leaving mechanism-dependent details to candidate-specific binding. For the 46 registered FunCADBench tasks, both prompts and test templates remain fixed across candidate designs.
blocks.zh: 构造器起自文字提示来指定功能要求,它描述机理在机械实现时必须完成什么. 例如,请求设置一个闹钟,可能要求它在特定时间自动触发,而无需规定特定的逃生设计. 每个测试模板都规定了用于验证所请求的行为的操作,观察和成功标准,将依赖机制的细节留给特定候选人来约束. 对于46项已登记的FunCADBench任务,各候选设计中的提示和测试模板都保持不变。

blocks.en: For requests outside the registered benchmark, the constructor first identifies the required functions, fixed constraints, and open operating parameters from the prompt, then proposes a test template. The test-binding agent checks its coverage and executability, and the constructor revises it accordingly. This additional template-authoring step is separate from the candidate-specific binding used to evaluate registered benchmark tasks.
blocks.zh: 对于注册基准以外的请求,构建者首先确定所需的函数,固定约束,以及从快取的开放操作参数,然后提出测试模板. 具有试验约束力的代理人检查其覆盖范围和可执行性,建筑师据此对其进行修改。 这个额外的模板授权步骤与用于评价已登记的基准任务的特定候选人约束不同.

blocks.en: 4.2 CAD construction and physical testing
blocks.zh: 4.2 CAD 建筑和物理测试

blocks.en: With the requirements and test templates in place, the constructor develops the CAD geometry, connections, operating inputs, and physical assumptions. The test-binding agent then binds each template to the candidate’s operating inputs and observable states without changing its geometry or declared mechanics. For the winch in Fig. 5 , this involves identifying the handle, release control, and load attachment and configuring tests of lifting, holding, release, and re-locking. The parameters needed to execute these tests come from the task, geometry, design documentation, or task-authorized constructor choices. Their sources and any permitted adjustments are retained as described in Appendix A.4 .
blocks.zh: 随着要求和测试模板的到位,构建器开发出CAD几何,连接,操作输入以及物理假设. 试验约束剂然后将每个模板与候选人的操作输入和可观察状态相接,而不改变其几何或宣布的力学。 对于图5中的绞盘,这涉及识别手柄、放行控制、加载附件和配置起重、牵引、放行和再上锁的测试。 进行这些测试所需的参数来自任务,几何,设计文件,或任务授权的构造者选择. 其来源和允许的任何调整均按附录A.4所述予以保留。

blocks.en: Once the physical experiments have been specified through binding, the harness executes them without changing the CAD design between tests and checks the original geometry at sampled motion poses (Section 3.3 ). The execution program determines the outcomes from the recorded signals and applicable geometry checks.
blocks.zh: 一旦通过捆绑对物理实验作出具体规定,这种带子就执行这些实验,而不改变试验之间的CAD设计,并检查取样运动所呈现的原始几何特征(第3.3节)。 执行程序确定所记录的信号和适用的几何检查的结果.

blocks.en: 4.3 Revision from physical feedback
blocks.zh: 4.3 实体反馈的修订

blocks.en: These outcomes return to the constructor as per-function results, accompanied by physical signals, failed checks, geometry violations, and execution errors. Using this feedback, the constructor diagnoses failures and revises the geometry, connections, permitted operating parameters, or simulation representations. Since a revision may affect several functions, the test-binding agent updates the candidate-specific bindings for all required functions, and the harness reruns the full set of tests on the revised assembly.
blocks.zh: 这些结果作为按功能计算的结果返回到构造器,同时伴有物理信号,故障检查,几何违规和执行错误. 构造者利用这种反馈来诊断故障并修改几何,连接,允许的操作参数,或者模拟表达. 由于修订可能影响多个功能,测试约束剂更新了所有需要的功能的候选特定约束,并重新对修订组装进行全套测试.

blocks.en: 5 Experiments and Results
blocks.zh: 5 实验和结果

blocks.en: 5.1 Functional Design Performance
blocks.zh: 5.1 功能设计性能

blocks.en: We evaluate GPT-6 Astra, Kimi K3, Fable 5.1, and Grok 4.6 with FunCAD-Harness on all 46 tasks (details in Table 7 ), allowing one independent attempt per family within a three-hour active-time budget. Each model drives its own ReAct loop ( Yao et al., 2023 ) for CAD construction, testing, and revision, with internal tests and revisions included in the generation process.
blocks.zh: 我们评价GPT-6 Astra、Kimi K3、Fable 5.1和Grok 4.6以及FunCAD-Harness的所有46个任务(详见表7),允许每个家庭在3小时的活跃时间预算中独立尝试一次。 每个模型都驱动自己的ReAct环(姚等,2023年)用于CAD的构建,测试和修订,内部测试和修订包含在生成过程中.

blocks.en: After each batch of generation runs, we evaluate the resulting assemblies in a separate batch using GPT-6 Astra with a one-million-token context allowance and medium reasoning. The final-evaluation model, context allowance, and reasoning setting remain the same across all generation models and comparison settings, including Grok + history. The evaluation agent configures candidate-specific physical tests under the task’s required functions and fixed constraints, and the execution program determines their outcomes. Appendix E.1 provides the model settings and time-accounting details.
blocks.zh: 在每一批人运行后,我们用GPT-6 Astra单独批次地对产生的组件进行评估,并配有100万托肯的上下文和中度推理。 包括Grok + 历史在内的所有代模型和比较设置中,最终评价模型,上下文允许度和推理设置保持不变. 评估代理机构根据任务要求的功能和固定的制约配置针对候选人的物理测试,执行方案决定其结果. 附录E.1提供了模型设置和时间核算的细节。

blocks.en: Across the four models, agents solve 34 of the 46 tasks (Fig. 6 ). All four succeed on most low-complexity tasks, but their performance diverges on more demanding mechanisms. Every task solved exclusively by Fable has medium or high complexity, although even this strongest model solves only five of the 15 high-complexity tasks. We also compare success across the benchmark’s demand axes by weighting each task according to its requirement grade on the corresponding axis. All four models have their lowest weighted success rate on the contact axis, which covers engagement, release, friction, and changes in contact state.
blocks.zh: 在四个模型中,代理解决了46个任务中的34个(图6. 这四个国家都成功地完成了最低复杂性的任务,但它们在要求更高的机制上的表现却各不相同。 由Fable独家解决的每一项任务都有中高复杂性,尽管即使这个最强的模型也只解决了15个高复杂性任务的5个. 我们还通过根据各项任务的要求等级在相应轴上加权来比较基准各需求轴的成败。 所有这四种模型在接触轴上都有最低的加权成功率,这涵盖了接触,释放,摩擦,以及接触状态的变化.

blocks.en: We also evaluate Grok with up to eight attempts per task and access to records from earlier attempts. This setting solves 36 tasks, including six unsolved by any model in the default setting, at a lower median cumulative constructor API cost than Astra’s default runs.
blocks.zh: 我们还对Grok进行评估,每项任务最多8次尝试,并查阅先前尝试的记录。 此设置可以解决36个任务,包括6个在默认设置中被任意模型所未解的任务,其中位累积构造器API成本低于Astra的默认运行.

blocks.en: Figure 6: Task success and mechanical demand coverage. (a) Tasks share an ordering across models. Colored segments indicate success, and gray segments indicate no recorded success. Individual outcomes appear in Table 8 . Time, tokens, and estimated constructor API cost are per-task medians. API cost covers recorded constructor usage and accumulates across attempts in the history setting (Appendix E.3 ). (b) Success weighted by requirement grades 1–3 for each demand axis, normalized by the total weight over all 46 tasks (Appendix E.5 ). Task grouping and demand-weighted scores use the four single-attempt settings.
blocks.zh: 图6:任务成功和机械需求覆盖。 (a) 任务分享各种模式的订单。 彩色片段表示成功,灰色片段表示没有记录成功. 个别结果见表8。 时间、标志和估计的建筑师API成本是每个任务中位数。 API成本涵盖已记录的构造器使用,并在历史背景中通过尝试来积累(附录E.3). (b) 按要求等级1至3对每个需求轴进行成功加权,按全部46项任务的总重量加以调整(附录E.5)。 任务分组和需求加权分数使用四个单试设置.

blocks.en: 5.2 Harness Comparisons
blocks.zh: 5.2 频率比较

blocks.en: To assess the contribution of structured physical testing, we compare FunCAD-Harness with three alternative workflows (Table 2 ). In the requirements-only and simulation-tools baselines, agents choose their own tests and may implement their own simulations. The binary-feedback variant retains the full harness workflow but returns only pass/fail simulation outcomes. We also test whether visual access contributes to construction and revision by repeating the Astra and Grok full-harness experiments with visual access removed only from the constructor. The other agents retain their standard visual access. All settings undergo independent final evaluation under the same protocol.
blocks.zh: 为了评估结构化物理测试的贡献,我们将FunCAD-Harness与三个备选工作流程进行比较(表2)。 在只要求和模拟工具的基线中,代理商选择自己的测试,并可能实施自己的模拟. 二进制-feedback变体保留了全取用的工作流程,但只返回通过/失败的模拟结果. 我们还通过重复Astra和Grok的全热实验来测试视觉访问是否有助于建筑和修正,而视觉访问只从构造器上取出. 其他特工则保留其标准的视觉访问. 所有设置都会根据同一协议接受独立的最终评价.

blocks.en: Table 2: End-to-end completion on 46 functional CAD tasks under independent final evaluation. Success-set overlaps appear in Appendix F .
blocks.zh: 表2:在独立最后评价下完成46项职能性CAD任务。 成功组合重叠载于附录F。

blocks.en: Simulation access and whole-task success. Providing simulation tools improves success over requirements alone, and the full harness raises it further, from 8 to 22 tasks for Astra and from 10 to 19 for Grok. These gains span motion transmission and locking through mechanical contact. Both models additionally solve the rack-and-pinion gate, four-bar wiper, and hand-cranked whisk (Tasks 2–4), as well as the self-locking knife and spring-latch lock (Tasks 5 and 33).
blocks.zh: 模拟访问和全任务成功. 提供模拟工具可以提高成功率,而不是仅仅满足要求,而充分利用将Astra的任务从8个提高到22个,Grok的任务从10个提高到19个。 这些收益跨越了运动传输和通过机械接触锁定. 这两个模型还额外地解决了架式和平板门,四巴式擦拭机,和手制的刷子(任务2–4)以及自锁刀和弹簧锁(任务5和33).

blocks.en: Access to simulation does not, however, ensure that the tests cover the complete requested behavior. In the simulation-tools setting, Astra tests a clock’s escapement for ten simulated minutes and its striker separately, but leaves the sequence of setting, triggering, and stopping the alarm while preserving timekeeping unverified. The delivered hour wheel also interferes with the alarm lever (Fig. 7 b).
blocks.zh: 然而,获得模拟并不能确保测试涵盖所要求的全部行为。 在模拟工具设定中, Astra 测试一个钟的出局时间为10个模拟分钟, 以及它的击出器分开, 但留下了设定、触发和停止警报的顺序, 交付的小时轮还干扰了报警杠杆(图7b.

blocks.en: Figure 7: Function-blocking interference in Astra designs produced without harness feedback. (a) The bicycle’s steering assembly intersects the fixed frame (Task 7, requirements-only ). (b) The clock’s hour wheel overlaps the alarm lever despite separate escapement and striker tests (Task 9, simulation-tools ). Red circles mark interference, and dashed silhouettes indicate intended poses. The clock inset uses schematic hand placement and sleeve length.
blocks.zh: 图7:在没有利用反馈的情况下对Astra设计的功能阻断干扰。 (a) 自行车的转向架组装与固定框架相交叉(任务7,只要求)。 (b) 钟表小时轮与警报杆重叠,尽管有单独的逃生和罢工测试(任务9,模拟工具)。 红色圆圈标出干扰,而破碎的圆筒标出意向的姿势. 时钟收录使用图示式的手放和袖口长度.

blocks.en: Retaining functional checks through revision. Functional checks can also be lost during repair. In the simulation-tools setting, Grok replaces a numerically invalid loaded test of a ratchet screwdriver (Task 13) with a short stepping test, leaving the drive and return-stroke requirements unchecked. A separate full-harness run retains these checks, revealing that all four stroke checks pass but both checks for backward slip of the output fail.
blocks.zh: 通过修订保留功能检查. 功能检查在修复过程中也可能丢失. 在模拟工具设置中,格罗克将鼠标螺旋桨(任务13)的数值无效的加载测试替换为短步测试,使驱动器和回放要求不受限制. 一次单独的全程检查保留了这些检查,显示所有四次中风检查都通过,但两次检查都显示输出失败了。

blocks.en: Diagnostic feedback and workflow completion. When a test fails, diagnostic feedback helps the constructor identify what needs to change. The full harness reports failed requirements, measured discrepancies, and physical-validity violations that can distinguish failure causes and guide repairs. Removing these diagnostics reduces recorded success from 22 to zero tasks for Astra and from 19 to eight for Grok. Astra’s binary-feedback runs include early delivery of partial results, so its zero successes include unfinished evaluation as well as failed checks. The benefit of diagnostic feedback extends to continued testing as well as design revision.
blocks.zh: 诊断反馈和完成工作流程。 当测试失败时,诊断反馈会帮助构建者确定需要改变什么. 全面利用报告未达到要求,测量了差异,以及可区分故障原因并指导修理的违反身体力能。 消除这些诊断使记录的成功从Astra的22个任务减为零,从Grok的19个减为8个。 Astra的二进制反馈运行包括提前提供部分结果,因此零成功包括未完成的评价以及失败的检查. 诊断反馈的好处扩大到继续测试和修改设计。

blocks.en: 5.3 Design and Revision Behavior
blocks.zh: 5.3 设计和修订行为

blocks.en: Repairing failures in repeated operation. Fable’s gripper (Task 41) passes a short development test, but formal repeated-use testing reveals that the workpiece tips after release, causing the next grasp to miss it. The second grasp records 0 N against a 10 N minimum. Fable responds by widening the contact pads and support rest and reducing the permitted input-force limit from 50 to 35 N. The revised design leaves the workpiece positioned for reuse, and its second grasp reaches 14.40 N under the unchanged 5 N external load. Both grasp–release cycles and the geometry audit pass (Fig. 11 ).
blocks.zh: 重复运行中修复故障. Fable的抓取者(任务41)通过了一个短暂的开发测试,但正式的重复使用测试显示,工作人員出道后提示,导致下个抓取失败. 第二次抓取记录为0 N对10 N最低. 有线电视通过扩大接触台和支持休息以及将允许的输入力限制从50纳到35纳来响应. 修改后的设计让工作台定位再利用,其第二次接力在不变的5N外载下达到14.40N. 既可抓取-放出周期,又可接取几何审计通行证(图11).

blocks.en: Restoring function can still leave geometric interference to resolve. In Grok’s spring-return door latch (Task 33), the latch initially rests on the strike-plate edge after closure, failing both re-locking checks while passing the other 13 functional checks. Grok reshapes the entry bevel and adds a catching shoulder, restoring engagement after both closures and passing all 15 functional checks. It then adds local relief to the faceplate to resolve the remaining latch–faceplate interference. The final revision passes both the functional checks and the audit of the original CAD geometry under unchanged test parameters (Fig. 8 ).
blocks.zh: 恢复功能仍然可以留下几何干扰来解决. 在格罗克的弹簧回放门锁(任务33)中,门锁最初在关闭后就位于罢工牌的边缘上,在通过其他13个功能性检查时都未能重新锁定检查。 Grok重塑了入门起伏器并增加了接球肩膀,在关闭后恢复接触,并通过所有15个功能检查. 然后在面板上添加了局部的解脱来解决剩余的锁-面板干扰. 最终修订通过功能检查和对原CAD几何学在不变测试参数下的审计(图8.

blocks.en: Figure 8: Grok repairs re-locking and local interference in a spring-return door latch (Task 33).
blocks.zh: 图8:Grok修理重新上锁和对弹簧回放门锁的局部干扰(任务33)。

blocks.en: Verification strategies and visual access. We analyze tool use on 41 task families with recorded harness-tool execution times for all four models (Appendix E.6 , Fig. 9 ). Fable and Grok devote larger shares of their calls to reading requirements, documentation, and source code. Astra devotes more to simulation, geometric checks, and analysis of test results and traces, with a higher share of simulation calls than Fable on 40 of the 41 matched tasks. Despite these differences in call distribution, simulation-related operations account for 75–85% of recorded harness-tool execution time on average across tasks for every model.

blocks.en: Agents obtain geometric and physical information primarily through CAD programs and simulation, with little use of rendered images. Without visual access, Astra’s constructor still succeeds on 20 of the 46 tasks, compared with 22 with visual access (Table 2 ). Grok shows a similar pattern, completing 18 tasks without visual access compared with 19 with it. Substantial functional design success therefore remains possible without visual inspection during construction and revision. Appendix F.5 provides the protocol and task-level results.

blocks.en: 5.4 Tool Use and Execution Time
blocks.zh: 5.4 工具使用和执行时间

blocks.en: We analyze tool use on 41 tasks with timing records available for all four models (Fig. 9 ). Fable and Grok devote larger shares of their calls to reading requirements, documentation, and source code, whereas Astra devotes more to simulation, geometric checks, and feedback analysis. These differences in call frequency do not translate into equally different execution-time profiles. For every model, simulation and cost probes account for approximately 75–85% of recorded tool execution time, even when they make up a small share of calls. Their cost highlights the importance of efficient simulation for repeated design revision. Across models, visual inspection remains infrequent, consistent with agents obtaining geometric and physical information primarily through CAD programs and numerical feedback.

blocks.en: 6 Discussions
blocks.zh: 讨论

blocks.en: From simulation to fabrication. Turning a simulated mechanism into a working machine requires accounting for uncertainty in both physics models and fabrication. Contact and friction approximations, manufacturing tolerances, assembly misalignment, and material variation can change whether parts slide, engage, or jam. Experiments with selected prototypes could calibrate uncertain parameters and identify missing effects, following approaches that calibrate simulators from real-world robot trajectories ( Chebotar et al., 2019 ) . Testing over plausible parameter ranges would then assess robustness to fabrication and operating conditions. The same prototype measurements could also help adapt world models, which offer fast predictions of rigid, articulated, and deformable interactions ( Huang et al., 2026 ; Yang et al., 2025 ) . Such adaptation could capture effects that are difficult to model explicitly and make repeated design tests more affordable.
blocks.zh: 从模拟到制造。 将模拟机制转变为工作机器需要考虑到物理模型和制造中的不确定性。 接触和摩擦相近,制造耐受性,组装错配,以及物质变化,可以改变部件滑行,接触或干扰. 使用所选原型的实验可以校正不确定参数并识别出缺失效应,遵循从现实世界机器人轨迹校正模拟器的方法(Chebotar等,2019年). 超过可能参数范围的测试将评估制造和操作条件的稳健性。 同样的原型测量还可以帮助调整世界模型,这些模型对僵硬、清晰和可变形的相互作用提供快速的预测(Huang等,2026;Yang等,2025)。 这种适应可捕捉难以明确模拟的效果,使重复设计试验更负担得起。

blocks.en: Coverage of functional tests. Improving simulation fidelity does not by itself ensure that the tests cover the intended behavior. Functional CAD design shares this challenge with project-level software generation in ProjectEval ( Liu et al., 2025 ) , where a high-level request must be translated into an artifact whose components work together. In both settings, ambiguous requirements and incomplete test suites can leave functions unchecked, while component tests may miss interactions. For mechanical systems, these interactions also depend on loads, initial states, and operation sequences, which determine contacts and the states available to later operations. Future harnesses could cover more of these conditions by combining requirement review and reusable engineering tests with automated searches for failure cases within the intended operating range ( Formica et al., 2024 ) . The resulting tests could guide revisions and check that later designs preserve previously verified behavior.
blocks.zh: 覆盖功能测试. 提高模拟忠诚性本身并不能确保测试涵盖预期行为。 功能性CAD设计与ProjectEval(Liu等,2025年)的项目级软件生成共同挑战,高级请求必须被转化为其组件协同工作的文物. 在两种设置中,模棱两可的要求和不完整的测试套件都可能使函数不受控制,而组件测试可能错过了交互. 对于机械系统来说,这些相互作用也取决于负载,初始状态,以及操作序列,它们决定了接触和以后操作可用的状态. 通过将要求审查和可再利用的工程测试与对预定操作范围内的故障情况进行自动搜索结合起来,未来的利用可以涵盖更多的这些条件(Formica等人,2024年)。 由此产生的测试可以指导修改和检查以后的设计保留以前核实的行为。

blocks.en: Multimodal interface fluency and physical reasoning. Despite its impressive visual 3D reconstruction capabilities ( Sun et al., 2026 ) , Astra does not dominate functional CAD design. Fable solves more tasks, while Grok with additional attempts and retained history exceeds the best default result at a lower median cumulative constructor API cost than Astra. This contrast raises the possibility that visual modeling performance partly reflects multimodal interface fluency rather than a corresponding advantage in physical reasoning. Our agents obtain geometric and physical information primarily through CAD programs and simulation, and Astra retains substantial task success when its constructor has no visual access. Given that targeted post-training can develop proficiency in computer-use and CAD workflows ( Ramrakhya et al., 2025 ; Gong et al., 2026 ) , training on these design–test–repair trajectories could improve functional design capabilities. Harnesses that help agents reuse prior designs and feedback could further improve the cost–performance tradeoff.
blocks.zh: 多式联运界面流畅与物理推理. 尽管其令人印象深刻的视觉3D重建能力(Sun等,2026年),Astra并不主导功能性的CAD设计. Fable解决了更多任务,而Grok附加尝试并保留了历史,以比Astra更低的中位累积构造器API成本超过了最佳的默认结果. 这种对比产生了一种可能性,即视觉建模性能部分反映了多式界面流畅性,而不是物理推理中的相应优势. 我们的代理人主要通过CAD程序和模拟获得几何和物理信息,而当Astra的构造器没有视觉访问时,Astra保留了巨大的任务成功. 鉴于有针对性的后培训可以培养计算机使用和CAD工作流程的熟练程度(Ramrakhya等人,2025年;Gong等人,2026年),关于这些设计-测试-修理轨迹的培训可以提高功能设计能力。 帮助物剂重新使用先前的设计和反馈的方法可以进一步改善成本-性能权衡。

blocks.en: 7 Concluding Remarks
blocks.zh: 7 结论意见

blocks.en: Turning a high-level request into a functional CAD mechanism requires connecting the intended behavior to physical tests that reflect how the design operates. Through FunCADBench and its 46 mechanism families, we study this connection and develop FunCAD-Harness to use the resulting feedback for design revision. Our experiments show that organizing physical testing around the requested functions substantially improves whole-task success over providing simulation tools alone, helping agents repair failures in coupled and repeated operations. These findings highlight the importance of integrating functional verification into generation as LLM agents move from constructing 3D geometry toward designing mechanisms for practical use.
blocks.zh: 将一个高层次的请求转化为一个功能性的CAD机制需要将预期的行为与反映设计如何运行的物理测试联系起来. 通过FunCADBench及其46个机制家族,我们研究了这种联系,并开发了FunCAD-Harness,利用由此产生的反馈进行设计修改. 我们的实验表明,围绕所要求的功能组织物理测试大大改进了整个任务的成功,而不是仅仅提供模拟工具,帮助代理人在连带和重复操作中修复故障。 这些调查结果突出表明,随着LLM剂从构建3D几何学转向设计实际使用的机制,将功能核查与生成相结合的重要性。

blocks.en: The task distinguishes required functions and explicit constraints from operating or performance parameters that the constructor may adjust. For example, a clamp task may permit changes to applied load or operating duration while still requiring closing, holding, and release. The constructor selects these values within the task’s permitted scope. The test-binding agent incorporates them into the test protocol and records their original values, revised values, and the reason for each change; programmatic validity checks remain in force. Completion is assessed under the final tested conditions, which are reported with the adjustment history.

rather than the internal steps of a particular implementation.

a functional requirement, whereas the escapement engaging a particular
tooth describes an implementation detail. Reuse the shared execution components and submit the proposed template
for independent review.

blocks.en: B.2 Taxonomy Dimensions and Representative Mechanisms
blocks.zh: B.2 分类问题和代表机制

blocks.en:
We characterize the mechanical demands of the tasks along five
complementary dimensions: motion primitives, topology, complexity,
contact, and geometric difficulty.
These dimensions are not mutually exclusive categories: a mechanism
family typically involves several dimensions, and task variants may
place different demands on each.

我们描述五个任务中的机械需求
互补维度:运动原始,地貌,复杂性,

家庭通常涉及几个层面,任务变体可能

blocks.en:
This dimension describes how a mechanism converts and transmits motion,
including input–output direction, phase relationships, and repeated or
intermittent operation.
In the four-bar wiper (3), continuous crank rotation must produce
repeated wiper oscillation, so evaluation must capture the input–output
relationship over complete motion cycles.

包括投入-产出方向、相接关系和重复或

blocks.en:
This dimension describes connections, branches, and closed kinematic
chains, together with the compatibility of the constraints they impose.
In the scissor lift (14), revolute and prismatic connections form closed
loops that constrain platform motion; the connections must therefore be
individually valid and collectively kinematically compatible.

链条,连同它们所施加的限制的相容性。

(b) 个人有效性和集体运动兼容性。

blocks.en:
This dimension describes interactions among components and subsystems,
state transitions, required operating sequences, and part count.
The mechanical alarm clock (9) couples energy supply, timekeeping, and
alarm operation through winding, running, and triggering, requiring
coordination across subsystems and states.

blocks.en:
This dimension describes how engagement, sliding, locking, friction,
and changes in contact state enable or prevent a behavior.
In the self-locking utility knife (5), pressing the release changes
the contact state to permit sliding, after which engagement at another
detent restores locking.

接触状态允许滑动,然后在另一个状态进行接触

blocks.en:
This dimension describes the feature construction, alignment, clearance
control, and assembly access needed to realize the intended mechanical
relationships.
The reversible dual-pawl ratchet wrench (34) illustrates these demands
through its pawl–tooth geometry, pivot fit, and local clearances, whose
shapes and relative placement must support the intended engagement.

关系

blocks.en:
The five dimensions interact: adding components may introduce new

The taxonomy therefore describes the mechanical diversity of the
benchmark, while performance on an individual family generally reflects

blocks.en: The comparisons in Section 5.2 examine three roles of the harness: providing access to physical simulation, maintaining coverage of the functional requirements, and returning evidence that guides revision. This appendix specifies the information available in each setting, lists the task-level outcomes, and uses selected trajectories to examine how agents test, revise, and decide when to stop.

blocks.en: F.1 Experimental Settings and Evaluation

blocks.en: All four settings start from the task’s functional requirements and permit CAD construction, source inspection, and static visualization. Table 13 distinguishes the supplied simulation support, responsibility for test coverage, and visible feedback. In the requirements-only setting, agents may still write verification code, including their own simulations. The simulation-tools setting supplies a simulator and guidance, while leaving the agent to select operating conditions, observations, and acceptance checks. The full harness additionally connects the candidate mechanism to requirement-level tests throughout design revision.

blocks.en: The binary-feedback setting restricts both development and formal simulation tests, as well as the standard validation interface, to pass/fail outcomes. The constructor cannot inspect the execution traces, measured residuals, validator diagnostics, or reviewer artifacts underlying these outcomes. It can still inspect its CAD source and static previews, perform its own geometric or analytical calculations, and request additional tests. This comparison asks whether correctness signals alone provide sufficient direction for repair. Simulation tools and binary feedback change both test organization and evidence access; they are complementary comparisons rather than successive levels of a single support variable.

blocks.en: Requirements-only and simulation-tools designs are adapted for evaluation after construction by a separate agent, whereas the harness settings expose requirement-level evaluation during revision. Post-hoc evaluation includes establishing an executable physical model of the delivered assembly. An incomplete adaptation or execution therefore leaves whole-task completion unestablished, without by itself identifying a mechanical defect. We report the same recorded whole-task outcomes as Table 2 ; passing an agent-written check is evidence only for that check’s scope. The binary-feedback analysis uses the isolated 46-task batch for each model, excluding the earlier development and pilot batches.

blocks.en: The simulation-tools trajectories contain active physical diagnosis and geometric repair. For example, Astra adds a detent to an indexing table after identifying motion during the intended dwell phase, then checks recovery from obstructions. Such behavior shows that agents can formulate useful experiments without the harness. The question is how those experiments collectively establish the requested function, and whether that target remains intact as the design and test code change.

blocks.en: The clock case illustrates why successful component tests do not establish the behavior of an assembled mechanism. The missing evidence concerns interactions between subsystems and the preservation of timekeeping through an alarm sequence. A requirement-level testbed makes these obligations explicit alongside tests of the escapement and striker. This connects functional decomposition to composition: individual tests must jointly cover the user’s requested behavior, including transitions between operations.
blocks.zh: 时钟案例说明了为什么成功的组件测试不能确定集合机制的行为. 所缺少的证据涉及子系统之间的相互作用和通过警报序列保持时间保持。 要求一级的试验台使这些义务与对逃脱者和罢工者进行测试一起明确。 这把功能分解与组成联系起来:单个测试必须共同覆盖用户要求的行为,包括操作之间的过渡.

blocks.en: The screwdriver case separates numerical recovery from functional recovery. Producing finite simulation states is useful, but it leaves unanswered whether the handle advances the output under load without undoing that motion on return. In a separate full-harness Grok run on Task 13, the second candidate passes both forward-advance and both handle-return checks, while both output-backslip checks remain failures. Although neither run records whole-task completion, the harness result identifies the outstanding requirement after partial progress. These are independently generated candidates; the comparison illustrates how the evaluation target is maintained during revision.
blocks.zh: 螺丝刀案将数字恢复与功能恢复区分开来. 产生有限度的模拟状态是有用的,但是,如果手柄在返回时不取消该运动,是否在负载下推进输出,则没有答案。 在任务13的一次单独的全速运行中,第二名候选人既通过前卫检查,又通过手柄回放检查,而两个输出回放检查仍然失败. 虽然没有运行整个任务完成记录,但利用结果确定了在部分进展后尚未满足的要求。 这些候选人是独立产生的;比较表明在修订期间如何维持评价目标。

blocks.en: F.4 Diagnosis and Stopping Under Binary Feedback
blocks.zh: F.4 诊断和二进制反馈

blocks.en: A failed test can reflect an incorrect input convention, obstructed motion, or an invalid execution setup. A pass/fail response does not distinguish these explanations. Table 16 shows three responses: designing tests that separate hypotheses, reconstructing evidence through independent geometric reasoning, and revising several plausible failure sources without confirming which caused the rejection.
blocks.zh: 失败的测试可以反映错误的输入常规,被阻碍的运动,或者无效的执行设置. 通过/失败的答复并不区分这些解释。 表16列出了三种答复:设计分离假设的测试,通过独立的几何推理重建证据,以及修订几种可能存在的故障源而未确认导致拒绝。

blocks.en: Table 16: Diagnostic strategies under binary feedback. Geometric and kinematic calculations are the agents’ own analyses, not hidden simulation traces.
blocks.zh: 表16:二进制反馈下的诊断策略。 几何和动能计算是物剂自己的分析,而不是隐藏的模拟痕迹.

blocks.en: Table 17 summarizes the recorded termination states in the binary-feedback batch. Astra chooses partial delivery in 43 of 46 runs, with a median of 137.8 minutes of active budget remaining at those decisions. Its explanations repeatedly cite insufficient evidence for a targeted next revision. Grok instead reaches the budget limit in 36 runs and completes eight. The same restricted feedback thus accompanies different search and stopping strategies; Astra’s zero recorded completions should not be read as 46 fully executed mechanical failures.
blocks.zh: 表17汇总了二进制反馈批次中记录的终止状态. Astra在46个业务中有43个业务选择部分交付,这些决定中尚有137.8分现行预算的中位数。 委员会的解释一再指出,下一次有针对性地修订证据不足。 格罗克则在36次运行中达到预算限额并完成8次. Astra的零记录完成不应被理解为46个完全执行的机械故障。

blocks.en: Table 17: Recorded termination states under binary feedback, with 46 runs per model. Categories are mutually exclusive. Evidence required denotes a recorded unresolved evidence state.
blocks.zh: 表17:记录的终止状态在二进制反馈下,每个模型有46个运行. 类别是相互排斥的。 所需证据表示有记录的未决证据状态。

blocks.en: Together, these observations separate a correctness signal from evidence for choosing a revision. Binary outcomes can guide repair through additional experiments or independent analysis. Detailed feedback supplies further information about the failed operation or validity condition, helping the agent select and verify its next change. The stopping counts compare models within the binary setting; estimating how masking changes each model’s stopping policy would require a paired analysis of the full-harness runs.
blocks.zh: 这些意见共同将正确性信号与选择修订的证据分开。 二进制结果可以通过额外的实验或独立分析来指导修复. 详细的反馈提供了操作失败或有效性条件的进一步信息,帮助代理选择并验证其下一次更改. 停止计数在二进制设置中比较模型; 估计掩盖会如何改变每个模型的停止政策, 需要对全速运行进行一对分析。

blocks.en: F.5 Construction Without Visual Access
blocks.zh: F.5 无视觉设施的建筑

blocks.en: Section 6 notes that agents rarely inspect rendered images during functional design. To test whether visual access nonetheless contributes to task success, we repeat the single-attempt Astra and Grok full-harness experiments with one additional restriction on the constructor. Task prompts, constructor instructions, the harness workflow, physical simulation, diagnostic numerical feedback, the active-time budget, and the independent final evaluation are identical to Section 5.1 . The constructor, however, cannot view, generate, or capture images, and cannot operate a computer or browser through screenshots. It cannot render the model through the harness preview tool, through its own scripts using plotting, imaging, or CAD visualization libraries, or through external modeling and rendering programs. It also cannot open image, video, 3D-viewer, HTML, or PDF files, and harness feedback returned to it contains only text and numerical values. The constructor retains its CAD source and exported geometry (STEP and STL), programmatic geometric queries, and simulation. The test-binding agent, independent review, and final evaluation keep their standard visual access, so the restriction removes visual information only from design and revision.
blocks.zh: 第6节指出,在功能设计期间,特工很少检查制作的图像。 为了测试视觉访问是否仍然有助于任务的成功,我们重复了单次尝试的Astra和Grok全热实验,对构造器增加了一个限制. 任务提示、构建者指示、利用工作流程、物理模拟、诊断数字反馈、活动时间预算以及独立最后评价与第5.1节相同。 然而,构建器无法查看,生成或捕获图像,也无法通过截图操作计算机或浏览器. 它不能通过控制器预览工具、使用绘图、成像或CAD可视化库制作自己的脚本,或通过外部模型制作和渲染程序制作模型。 它也无法打开图像,视频,3D-查看器,HTML,或PDF文件,并控制返回到它的反馈只包含文本和数字值. 构造器保留其CAD源并导出几何(STEP和STL),程序几何查询和模拟. 具有测试约束力的代理,独立审查,以及最终评价都保持了标准视觉访问,因此限制只从设计和修改中删除了视觉信息.

blocks.en: Table 18 compares the two runs. Without visual access, Astra completes 20 of the 46 tasks, compared with 22 with visual access. Sixteen tasks are solved in both settings. Six are solved only with visual access: the four-bar wiper, piston pump, two-digit counter, gravity-pawl turntable, tilting mirror, and folding shopping cart (Tasks 3, 17, 19, 23, 28, and 37). Four are solved only without it: the hinged toolbox, scissor lift, toggle clamp, and parallel gripper (Tasks 1, 14, 16, and 41). Grok shows a similar pattern: without visual access, it completes 18 of the 46 tasks, compared with 19 with visual access; 14 tasks are solved in both settings, five only with visual access, and four only without it.
blocks.zh: 表18比较了这两项活动。 没有视觉访问,Astra完成46个任务中的20个,而22个则有视觉访问. 在两种设置中都解决了16个任务. 六只用可视取用解决:四巴擦拭机,活塞泵,二位数计数器,重力活盘转盘,倾斜镜,和折叠购物车(任务3,17,19,23,28和37). 四个只解决了没有它的问题:有链条的工具箱、剪刀起重机、切换夹子和平行抓取器(任务1、14、16和41)。 Grok显示了类似的模式:没有视觉访问,它完成46个任务中的18个,相比之下,有19个任务有视觉访问;有14个任务在两种设置中被解决,有5个任务只有视觉访问,有4个任务没有视觉访问.

blocks.en: Removing visual access therefore changes the aggregate count by two tasks, while the sets of solved tasks differ in ten. With one attempt per task, these task-level differences cannot be attributed to visual access alone. The aggregate result nevertheless indicates that, within FunCAD-Harness, the constructor’s functional success depends mainly on CAD programs, geometric queries, and simulation feedback rather than on visual inspection, consistent with the tool-use profiles in Appendix E.6 . Figure 13 shows the 20 designs completed without visual access, and Figure 14 shows the 18 designs completed by Grok without visual access.
blocks.zh: 因此去除可视化访问会将集合计数改变为两个任务,而已解的任务组则在十个中有所区别. 单凭每个任务一次尝试,这些任务层面的差异不能归咎于视觉访问. 然而,总体结果表明,在FunCAD-Harness中,建筑师的功能成功主要取决于CAD程序、几何查询和模拟反馈,而不是视觉检查,这符合附录E.6中的工具使用概况。 图13显示20个没有视觉访问完成的设计,图14显示Grok没有视觉访问完成的18个设计.

blocks.en: F.6 Repeated Attempts Without Shared Records
blocks.zh: F.6 没有共享记录的重复尝试

blocks.en: The Grok + history setting in Section 5.1 allows up to eight attempts per task, each with access to records from earlier attempts, and completes 36 of the 46 tasks. To separate the contribution of these records from that of additional sampling, we repeat the eight-attempt Grok experiment with one change: each attempt can access only its own artifacts and cannot read the designs, tests, feedback, or other records produced by any other attempt. Task prompts, constructor instructions, the full-harness workflow, the per-attempt budget, and the final evaluation are otherwise identical. All eight attempts are executed for every task, and a task counts as completed if at least one attempt passes the formal evaluation.
blocks.zh: 第5.1节中的Grok + 历史设定允许每次任务最多8次尝试,每次尝试都可以取用以前尝试的记录,完成46个任务中的36个. 为了区分这些记录与额外采样的贡献,我们用一个变化重复了8个尝试的格罗克实验:每次尝试只能访问自己的文物,不能读取任何其他尝试产生的设计,测试,反馈或其他记录. 任务提示,构建者指令,全勤工作流程,每勤预算,最终评价在其他方面是完全相同的. 所有八次尝试都为每一项任务执行,如果至少有一次尝试通过正式评价,一项任务就算完成。

blocks.en: Table 19 lists the outcomes. Individual batches complete between 15 and 18 of the 46 tasks (129 passing runs out of 368, or 16.1 tasks per batch on average), comparable to the single-attempt Grok configuration in Table 8 (19/46). Taking the union over eight independent attempts raises completion to 24 of the 46 tasks, compared with 36 when attempts share records. Relative to a single attempt, additional independent sampling thus adds five tasks, whereas eight attempts with shared records add 17. The union includes seven tasks not completed by the single-attempt run (Tasks 1, 10, 12, 18, 23, 25, and 38) but misses two that it completes, the self-locking utility knife and gravity timer (Tasks 5 and 21), reflecting run-to-run variation at a fixed configuration.
blocks.zh: 表19列出了结果。 46个任务中有15个完成至18个完成(每批368个任务中有129个通过,平均每批16.1个任务完成),与表8(19/46)中的单试格罗克配置相当. 8次独立尝试使46项任务中的24项完成,而36项尝试共享记录。 因此,与单一尝试相比,额外的独立取样增加了五项任务,而共有记录的8项尝试增加了17项。 该联盟包括了由单试跑(任务1,10,12,18,23,25和38)未完成的7项任务,但错过了它完成的2项任务,即自锁功用刀和重力定时器(任务5和21),在固定配置中反映了跑到跑的变化.

blocks.en: Outcomes across attempts are also uneven. Seven tasks pass in all eight attempts, whereas six of the 24 completed tasks pass in at most two, and 22 tasks are completed by no attempt. Without shared records, each attempt restarts from the task description, so repeated sampling mainly recovers tasks that a single attempt already solves with moderate probability. Figure 15 shows one passing design for each of the 24 tasks completed by at least one independent attempt.
blocks.zh: 各种尝试的结果也参差不齐。 在所有8次尝试中,有7次任务通过,而在24次完成的任务中,有6次最多两次通过,22次没有尝试完成。 没有共享的记录,每次尝试都会从任务描述中重新开始,因此重复的采样主要回收一次尝试已经以中度概率解决的任务. 图15显示至少一次独立尝试完成的24项任务中的每一项都有一个通过设计。
